pin_diff.note: Functionally identical GND pin (GND vs ADJ/GND).

parameter_matrix.note: A part wins only if its operating Vin range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.

parameter_matrix.part_a_value: ESR-Sensitive · >=22 µF · See datasheet ESR curve
parameter_matrix.note: Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: CAUTION OUTPUT CAPACITANCE: Minimum Cout differs by 2.2x (AMS1117-3.3: 22 µF p.4 vs LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB: 10 µF p.15); account for MLCC DC-bias derating.
CAUTION ESR STABILITY WINDOW: Both parts are ESR-constrained, but AMS1117-3.3 omits explicit numeric ESR bounds (See datasheet ESR curve vs 0.3–22 Ω (p.15)); verify the datasheet ESR-vs-Iout curve.
HIGH LOAD CURRENT DERATING: LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB supplies up to 800 mA (p.7) compared to AMS1117-3.3 at 1000 mA (p.1); confirm peak inrush and thermal dissipation margin.

HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: AMS1117-3.3 has a lower Vin,abs,max rating (15 V, p.2) than LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB (20 V, p.4); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 15 V.
HIGH THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA is 46% higher on AMS1117-3.3 (AMS1117-3.3: 90 °C/W p.2 vs LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB: 61.6 °C/W p.4); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
engineering_verdict: AMS1117-3.3 (Advanced Monolithic Systems, SOT-223-3) and LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB (Texas Instruments, SOT-223-3) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because minimum output capacitance requirement differs 2.2x; ESR-constrained output capacitor window unverified on one part; Iout,max rating drops >=20%. Under a representative 5 V → 3.3 V rail at 150 mA (255 mW), estimated self-heating is ΔTj ≈ 22.9 °C on AMS1117-3.3 (θJA 90 °C/W) vs 15.7 °C on LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB (θJA 61.6 °C/W), while quiescent draw spans a 1x ratio (5000 µA (p.3) vs 5000 µA (p.8)). Primary bench gotchas to watch: AMS1117-3.3 "NOT Ceramic-Cap Stable — Requires 22 uF Solid Tantalum (No Numeric ESR Window Published)" (p.4) and LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB "Strict 0.3–22 Ohm ESR Window — Unstable With Direct MLCC Ceramic Output Capacitors" (p.15). BOM decision: Choose AMS1117-3.3 when load current exceeds 800 mA (up to 1000 mA); choose LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB when lower package θJA (61.6 °C/W) is needed for thermal margin. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
